scope_review.relation_rationale: This is the requested primary composite: cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure, analyzed as time to first event, with a reported HR of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.65 to 0.86). The supplement's event criteria confirm that HF hospitalization entails new or worsening symptoms and objective evidence of worsening HF, matching the target's worsening-HF hospitalization. The target follows participants from randomization for the full trial follow-up, rather than estimating fixed-duration risk; median follow-up was 16 months. Event totals were 361/1863 versus 462/1867. The Cox-model ITT comparison corresponds to assignment to empagliflozin versus placebo.

target.outcome: Composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure, time to first event
target.measurement: First occurrence of adjudicated cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure; the hospitalization definition requires an adjudicated primary HF diagnosis, documented new or worsening HF symptoms, and objective new or worsening HF evidence.
target.window: From randomization through the entire duration of trial follow-up (median follow-up 16 months); not a fixed-duration event risk.
target.population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups
comparison: Empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) in addition to usual therapy for heart failure
Placebo in addition to usual therapy for heart failure

scope_review.reported_analysis_population: All 3730 randomized patients (1863 empagliflozin; 1867 placebo), analyzed by intention-to-treat using data through the end of the planned treatment period.
